FEAT-1-STORY-028.description: Implement and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, filters) and outputs (ranked providers, metadata, fallback indicators) to enforce strict contract between tool layer and domain services.

FEAT-1-STORY-029.description: Wire provider search functionality through find_care_facade and register it with tool_router to enable LLM-driven invocation with validated inputs and structured outputs.

FEAT-1-STORY-030.title: Integrate specialty identification into provider search pipeline
